page.overview:
Who is Jess?

Jess is a character from The Cliffs, the first story in the book of the same name. She's a bespectacled copy editor that tries to reconnect with Robert after he isolates himself from others.

Jess isn’t described much other than that she wears eyeglasses. In the graphic novel, she has a round face, brown eyes, blue glasses, a pointy nose, and bright red hair that is half shaven. Jess also has black eyeliner and pink lipstick.

Jess is nice and a self-confessed “grammar nerd.” Being a single parent, she relates to Robert a lot and acts caring towards him. Jess also likes joking around and being playful.

Jess was hired as a copy editor for the magazine company at the same time Robert was. They were good friends and used to chat in the past, but when Anna died Robert cut himself off in order to focus his attention of Tyler.
